slides.title: Your spot is your spot.
slides.body: Nobody assigned it. Take someone else's once and you'll feel the stare for a month.

slides.title: The good rope is never free.
slides.body: There are forty skipping ropes. One is the right length. Someone hid it in 2023.

slides.title: Strip your bar. Every plate.
slides.body: A 20 left on the bar is not a gift for the next class.

slides.title: The last one finishing gets the loudest cheer.
slides.body: Everyone stays. Everyone claps. No exceptions.

slides.title: The playlist is not a request line.
slides.body: You can ask. You'll still get the same playlist as last week.

slides.title: Chalk stays in the bucket.
slides.body: Not on the rower. Not on the floor. Definitely not on the coach.
